title: Jesus... I'm Always The One Who Texts First
topic: she always texts first and wonders if anyone would notice if she stopped

bible.text: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm always the one who texts first. What happens if I just stop? 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Yesterday I tried. Nobody checked on me. Twenty-four hours of nothing.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You counted every hour, hoping someone would prove you matter. You never needed their proof.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But does nobody noticing mean nobody loves me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It means the people around you got comfortable being carried. Comfortable is not careless, but it still hurts.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So do I keep initiating, or let the friendships shrink to what they give back?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep showing up, because that's who you are. But tell one friend the truth tonight: I miss being pursued too.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if I say it and still nothing changes?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then hear this: I have pursued you every single day, and I have never once been too tired to text first.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are carved somewhere no one can forget. Start there tonight.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who would notice if you went quiet? 💔
